attributes.action: Use National Phone Alerts for Missing Children/Vulnerable Persons
attributes.additional_details: The government has an emergency alert system to warn the nation of important events such as adverse weather etc, via a message to their mobile phones. This proposal requests that this system, or something similar is used/introduced to send alerts of missing young children and vulnerable persons in areas, increasing awareness and chances that the person will be found.
attributes.background: The government use UK Emergency Alerts to quickly notify of missing children and vulnerable persons.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Establish a national alert system for missing autistic & vulnerable people
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778218
